# Westside-Old Window Repair

> Repair — not replacement — of original double-hung, casement and storm windows in Cincinnati's older West Side homes. Owner Mark Gay has 40+ years of hands-on experience. Phone: (513) 921-1244. Service-area business based in Cincinnati, Ohio (no walk-in showroom).

## Key facts
- Business name on Google: Westside - Old Window Repair
- Phone: (513) 921-1244
- Hours: Mon 9:00 AM–3:00 PM; Tue–Fri 9:00 AM–4:30 PM; Sat 9:00 AM–2:00 PM; Sun closed
- Service area (matches the Google Business Profile): Covedale, Delhi Township, Westwood, West Price Hill — Cincinnati's West Side
- Services: window sash repair and double-hung window repair (sash cord replacement, re-roping, rebalancing, freeing painted-shut sashes), window reglazing / glazing repair and minor window frame repair, casement window repair, storm window repair (storm panels)
- Also described as: old window repair, wood window repair, wood window restoration, historic / vintage / antique window repair, window repair Cincinnati OH
- Does NOT sell or install replacement windows; does not service vinyl/aluminum replacement units
- Owner Mark Gay was born and raised in West Price Hill and still lives there
- Google Maps listing: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=5809751457807609231
